Definition
[piecewise differentiable curve]

1. ch3:3.1A piecewise differentiable curve is a continuous map $c:[a,b]\to M$ for which there is a partition $a=t_0<t_1<\dots <t_k=b$ such that each restriction $c|_{[t_i,t_{i+1}]}$ is differentiable; $c$ joins $c(a)$ and $c(b)$. $c(t_i)$ is a vertex of $c$, and the vertex angle at $c(t_i)$ is the angle between $\lim _{t\to t_i^+}c'(t)$ and $\lim _{t\to t_i^-}c'(t)$. Parallel transport extends to such curves by transporting successively over each differentiable segment.
